Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Group Levelling patrol locations and monsters together by zone.
- Show every known species matching your level range within its category.
- Target or ignore species directly inside the grouped selector.
